cond_0001.intro: Entry to mid-entry level Materials Analyst position. Responsible for managing the material supply line from supplier to end customer. This includes maintenance of item master parameters in the ERP system, communication of any potential supply interruptions, general management of assigned suppliers, and the achievement of raw material inventory turns and dollar value goals.
cond_0001.responsibilities: The Materials Analyst is Responsible for communication and coordination of parts requirements to the supply base to support customer demand. Maintains ERP system for all Material functional areas such as Item Master, BOM, ship to locations, and inventory parameters. Assist in coordination and analysis of material in support of inventory build-outs and start-ups of new programs. Cross-training in all production control functions for replacement as needed. Maintenance of all material receipts in helping to maintain an accurate perpetual inventory reporting system. Advise and assist staff (Operations, Production, Production Control, and Purchasing) by periodic analysis and reporting of expedited shipments, supplier rating systems, and monthly inventory levels. Assist in the decision-making process for critical material shortages. Utilize methods for continuous improvement. Tracks component inventory inaccuracies for root cause identification and corrective action(s). Responsible for ensuring the issue(s) are corrected. Responsible for performing daily cycle counts and reconciliation of inventory variances. Responsible to track the status of supplier communication for engineering changes as proposed by program management. Responsible for reporting daily on all key performance measures of the materials department, including inventory valuation, cycle counts and inventory accuracy, and past-due parts. Must be willing to report unsafe conditions, report unsafe acts, participate in safety/ergo committees, participate in safety Kaizen events, participate in blue sky initiatives, participate in safety audits, and participate in safety observation feedback events. Assist the plant in achieving safety goals and achieving and maintaining AMS objectives. Participate in communications events such as plant-wide meetings, line meetings, department meetings, and training exercises. Will follow and promote environmental management system compliance and commitment to resource conservation.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
College Degree or equivalent 2+ years Production Control with material coordination emphasis.
Knowledgeable with ERP systems.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with QAD ERP system.
Previous experience in Automotive / J-I-T plants.

cond_0116.intro: Entry to mid-entry level Materials Analyst position. The role is responsible for managing the material supply line from supplier to end customer. This includes maintaining item master parameters in the ERP system, communicating potential supply interruptions, managing assigned suppliers, and achieving raw material inventory turns and dollar value goals.
cond_0116.responsibilities: The Materials Analyst owns communication and coordination of parts requirements to the supply base to support customer demand. Maintains ERP system for all Material functional areas such as Item Master, BOM, ship to locations, and inventory parameters. Leads coordination and analysis of material in support of inventory build-outs and start-ups of new programs. Cross-training in all production control functions for replacement as needed. Takes ownership of all material receipts to maintain an accurate perpetual inventory reporting system. Delivers periodic analysis and reporting of expedited shipments, supplier rating systems, and monthly inventory levels to staff in Operations, Production, Production Control, and Purchasing. Drives the decision-making process for critical material shortages. Executes methods for continuous improvement. Tracks component inventory inaccuracies for root cause identification and corrective action(s), and ensures issues are resolved. Performs daily cycle counts and reconciliation of inventory variances. Tracks the status of supplier communication for engineering changes as proposed by program management. Reports daily on all key performance measures of the materials department, including inventory valuation, cycle counts and inventory accuracy, and past-due parts. Must be willing to report unsafe conditions, report unsafe acts, participate in safety/ergo committees, participate in safety Kaizen events, participate in blue sky initiatives, participate in safety audits, and participate in safety observation feedback events. Leads plant efforts in achieving safety goals and achieving and maintaining AMS objectives. Participates in communications events such as plant-wide meetings, line meetings, department meetings, and training exercises. Will follow and promote environmental management system compliance and commitment to resource conservation.
cond_0116.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
College Degree or equivalent 2+ years Production Control with material coordination emphasis.
Knowledgeable with ERP systems.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with QAD ERP system.
Previous experience in Automotive / J-I-T plants.

cond_0127.responsibilities: The Materials Analyst is Responsible for communication and coordination of parts requirements to the supply base to support customer demand. Maintains ERP system for all Material functional areas such as Item Master, BOM, ship to locations, and inventory parameters. Assist in coordination and analysis of material in support of inventory build-outs and start-ups of new programs. Cross-training in all production control functions for replacement as needed. Maintenance of all material receipts in helping to maintain an accurate perpetual inventory reporting system. Advise and assist staff (Operations, Production, Production Control, and Purchasing) by periodic analysis and reporting of expedited shipments, supplier rating systems, and monthly inventory levels. Assist in the decision-making process for critical material shortages. Utilize methods for continuous improvement. Tracks component inventory inaccuracies for root cause identification and corrective action(s). Responsible for ensuring the issue(s) are corrected. Responsible for performing daily cycle counts and reconciliation of inventory variances. Responsible to track the status of supplier communication for engineering changes as proposed by program management. Responsible for reporting daily on all key performance measures of the materials department, including inventory valuation, cycle counts and inventory accuracy, and past-due parts. Must be willing to report unsafe conditions, report unsafe acts, participate in safety/ergo committees, participate in safety Kaizen events, participate in blue sky initiatives, participate in safety audits, and participate in safety observation feedback events. Assist the plant in achieving safety goals and achieving and maintaining AMS objectives. Participate in communications events such as plant-wide meetings, line meetings, department meetings, and training exercises. Will follow and promote environmental management system compliance and commitment to resource conservation.
cond_0127.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
College Degree or equivalent 2+ years Production Control with material coordination emphasis.
Knowledgeable with ERP systems.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with QAD ERP system.
Previous experience in Automotive / J-I-T plants.

This includes maintenance of item master parameters in the ERP system, communication of any potential supply interruptions, general management of assigned suppliers, and the achievement of raw material inventory turns and dollar value goals.
cond_0214.responsibilities:
The Materials Analyst is responsible for coordinating parts requirements to the supply base to support customer demand.
Maintains ERP system for all Material functional areas such as Item Master, BOM, ship to locations, and inventory parameters.
Supports coordination and analysis of material for inventory build-outs and start-ups of new programs.
Cross-training in all production control functions for replacement as needed.
Maintenance of all material receipts to help maintain an accurate perpetual inventory reporting system.
Provides periodic analysis and reporting of expedited shipments, supplier rating systems, and monthly inventory levels to Operations, Production, Production Control, and Purchasing staff.
Supports the decision-making process for critical material shortages.
Utilizes methods for continuous improvement.
Tracks component inventory inaccuracies for root cause identification and corrective action(s). Responsible for ensuring the issue(s) are corrected.
Responsible for performing cycle counts and reconciliation of inventory variances.
Tracks the status of supplier communication for engineering changes as proposed by program management.
Responsible for reporting on all key performance measures of the materials department, including inventory valuation, cycle counts and inventory accuracy, and past-due parts.
Must be willing to report unsafe conditions, report unsafe acts, participate in safety/ergo committees, participate in safety Kaizen events, participate in blue sky initiatives, participate in safety audits, and participate in safety observation feedback events.
Supports the plant in achieving safety goals and achieving and maintaining AMS objectives.
Attends plant-wide meetings, line meetings, department meetings, and training exercises as required.
Will follow and promote environmental management system compliance and commitment to resource conservation.
cond_0214.requirements:
College Degree or equivalent 2+ years Production Control with material coordination emphasis.
Knowledgeable with ERP systems - QAD is Preferred
Previous experience in Automotive / J-I-T plants preferred

Responsible for reporting daily on all key performance measures of the materials department, including inventory valuation, cycle counts and inventory accuracy, and past-due parts. Must be willing to report unsafe conditions, report unsafe acts, participate in safety/ergo committees, participate in safety Kaizen events, participate in blue sky initiatives, participate in safety audits, and participate in safety observation feedback events. Assist the plant in achieving safety goals and achieving and maintaining AMS objectives. Participate in communications events such as plant-wide meetings, line meetings, department meetings, and training exercises. Will follow and promote environmental management system compliance and commitment to resource conservation.

cond_0258.intro: Entry to mid-entry level Materials Analyst position. The role involves managing the material supply line from supplier to end customer. This includes maintaining item master parameters in the ERP system, communicating potential supply interruptions, managing assigned suppliers, and meeting raw material inventory turns and dollar value goals. A regular part of the role is staying in contact with suppliers, internal staff, and cross-functional teams to keep material flow on track.
cond_0258.responsibilities: The Materials Analyst is responsible for communicating and coordinating parts requirements to the supply base to support customer demand. Maintains ERP system for all Material functional areas such as Item Master, BOM, ship to locations, and inventory parameters. Connects with Operations, Production, Production Control, and Purchasing staff regularly to share analysis and reporting on expedited shipments, supplier rating systems, and monthly inventory levels. Assists in coordination and analysis of material in support of inventory build-outs and start-ups of new programs. Cross-training in all production control functions for replacement as needed. Maintains all material receipts to help keep an accurate perpetual inventory reporting system. Actively contributes to the decision-making process for critical material shortages. Utilizes methods for continuous improvement. Tracks component inventory inaccuracies for root cause identification and corrective action(s), and ensures issues are corrected. Performs daily cycle counts and reconciliation of inventory variances. Tracks the status of supplier communication for engineering changes as proposed by program management. Reports daily on all key performance measures of the materials department, including inventory valuation, cycle counts and inventory accuracy, and past-due parts. Must be willing to report unsafe conditions, report unsafe acts, participate in safety/ergo committees, participate in safety Kaizen events, participate in blue sky initiatives, participate in safety audits, and participate in safety observation feedback events. Assists the plant in achieving safety goals and achieving and maintaining AMS objectives. Participates in and actively engages in communications events such as plant-wide meetings, line meetings, department meetings, and training exercises. Will follow and promote environmental management system compliance and commitment to resource conservation.
cond_0258.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
College Degree or equivalent 2+ years Production Control with material coordination emphasis.
Knowledgeable with ERP systems.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with QAD ERP system.
Previous experience in Automotive / J-I-T plants.

This includes maintenance of item master parameters in the ERP system, communication of any potential supply interruptions, general management of assigned suppliers, and the achievement of raw material inventory turns and dollar value goals.
cond_0304.responsibilities:
The Materials Analyst is responsible for coordinating parts requirements to the supply base to support customer demand.
Maintains ERP system for all Material functional areas such as Item Master, BOM, ship to locations, and inventory parameters.
Supports coordination and analysis of material for inventory build-outs and start-ups of new programs.
Cross-training in all production control functions for replacement as needed.
Maintenance of all material receipts to help maintain an accurate perpetual inventory reporting system.
Provides periodic analysis and reporting of expedited shipments, supplier rating systems, and monthly inventory levels to Operations, Production, Production Control, and Purchasing staff.
Supports the decision-making process for critical material shortages.
Utilizes methods for continuous improvement.
Tracks component inventory inaccuracies for root cause identification and corrective action(s). Responsible for ensuring the issue(s) are corrected.
Responsible for performing cycle counts and reconciliation of inventory variances.
Tracks the status of supplier communication for engineering changes as proposed by program management.
Responsible for reporting on all key performance measures of the materials department, including inventory valuation, cycle counts and inventory accuracy, and past-due parts.
Must be willing to report unsafe conditions, report unsafe acts, participate in safety/ergo committees, participate in safety Kaizen events, participate in blue sky initiatives, participate in safety audits, and participate in safety observation feedback events.
Supports the plant in achieving safety goals and achieving and maintaining AMS objectives.
Attends plant-wide meetings, line meetings, department meetings, and training exercises as required.
Will follow and promote environmental management system compliance and commitment to resource conservation.

Assists in coordinating and analyzing material to support inventory build-outs and start-ups of new programs. Cross-trains in all production control functions to provide coverage as needed. Helps maintain accurate perpetual inventory reporting through coordination of material receipts. Supports staff in Operations, Production, Production Control, and Purchasing through periodic analysis and reporting of expedited shipments, supplier rating systems, and monthly inventory levels. Assists in the decision-making process for critical material shortages. Works with the team on continuous improvement methods. Tracks component inventory inaccuracies together with relevant teams for root cause identification and corrective action, and helps ensure issues are resolved. Performs daily cycle counts and works with others to reconcile inventory variances. Coordinates with program management to track supplier communication on engineering changes. Shares daily reporting on key performance measures for the materials department, including inventory valuation, cycle counts, inventory accuracy, and past-due parts. Participates in safety efforts including reporting unsafe conditions and acts, safety and ergo committees, safety Kaizen events, blue sky initiatives, safety audits, and safety observation feedback events. Supports the plant in achieving safety goals and maintaining AMS objectives. Takes part in plant-wide meetings, line meetings, department meetings, and training exercises. Follows and promotes environmental management system compliance and commitment to resource conservation.
cond_0387.requirements:

College degree or equivalent 2+ years in Production Control with a material coordination emphasis
Working knowledge of ERP systems

Experience with QAD ERP
Previous experience in Automotive or J-I-T plants

People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp how material flow and inventory systems fit together.
cond_0427.responsibilities: The Materials Analyst is Responsible for communication and coordination of parts requirements to the supply base to support customer demand. Maintains ERP system for all Material functional areas such as Item Master, BOM, ship to locations, and inventory parameters. Assist in coordination and analysis of material in support of inventory build-outs and start-ups of new programs. Cross-training in all production control functions for replacement as needed. Maintenance of all material receipts in helping to maintain an accurate perpetual inventory reporting system. Advise and assist staff (Operations, Production, Production Control, and Purchasing) by periodic analysis and reporting of expedited shipments, supplier rating systems, and monthly inventory levels. Assist in the decision-making process for critical material shortages. Utilize methods for continuous improvement. Tracks component inventory inaccuracies for root cause identification and corrective action(s). Responsible for ensuring the issue(s) are corrected. Responsible for performing daily cycle counts and reconciliation of inventory variances. Responsible to track the status of supplier communication for engineering changes as proposed by program management. Responsible for reporting daily on all key performance measures of the materials department, including inventory valuation, cycle counts and inventory accuracy, and past-due parts. Must be willing to report unsafe conditions, report unsafe acts, participate in safety/ergo committees, participate in safety Kaizen events, participate in blue sky initiatives, participate in safety audits, and participate in safety observation feedback events. Assist the plant in achieving safety goals and achieving and maintaining AMS objectives. Participate in communications events such as plant-wide meetings, line meetings, department meetings, and training exercises. Will follow and promote environmental management system compliance and commitment to resource conservation.
cond_0427.requirements:
College Degree or equivalent 2+ years Production Control with material coordination emphasis.
Knowledgeable with ERP systems - QAD is Preferred
Previous experience in Automotive / J-I-T plants preferred
cond_0427.values: We value excellence and take pride in delivering strong results. We aim to hold a high standard in our work and in the outcomes we create.

This includes maintenance of item master parameters in the ERP system, communication of any potential supply interruptions, general management of assigned suppliers, and the achievement of raw material inventory turns and dollar value goals.
cond_0485.responsibilities: The Materials Analyst owns communication and coordination of parts requirements to the supply base to support customer demand. Maintains ERP system for all Material functional areas such as Item Master, BOM, ship to locations, and inventory parameters. Leads coordination and analysis of material in support of inventory build-outs and start-ups of new programs. Cross-training in all production control functions for replacement as needed. Manages all material receipts to maintain an accurate perpetual inventory reporting system. Advises and directs staff (Operations, Production, Production Control, and Purchasing) through periodic analysis and reporting of expedited shipments, supplier rating systems, and monthly inventory levels. Drives the decision-making process for critical material shortages. Executes methods for continuous improvement. Tracks component inventory inaccuracies for root cause identification and corrective action(s). Accountable for ensuring the issue(s) are corrected. Responsible for performing daily cycle counts and reconciliation of inventory variances. Responsible to track the status of supplier communication for engineering changes as proposed by program management. Responsible for reporting daily on all key performance measures of the materials department, including inventory valuation, cycle counts and inventory accuracy, and past-due parts. Must be willing to report unsafe conditions, report unsafe acts, participate in safety/ergo committees, participate in safety Kaizen events, participate in blue sky initiatives, participate in safety audits, and participate in safety observation feedback events. Leads the plant in achieving safety goals and achieving and maintaining AMS objectives. Participate in communications events such as plant-wide meetings, line meetings, department meetings, and training exercises. Will follow and promote environmental management system compliance and commitment to resource conservation.
cond_0485.requirements:
College Degree or equivalent 2+ years Production Control with material coordination emphasis.
Knowledgeable with ERP systems - QAD is Preferred
Previous experience in Automotive / J-I-T plants preferred

People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with materials coordination and ERP systems.
cond_0509.responsibilities: The Materials Analyst is responsible for communication and coordination of parts requirements to the supply base to support customer demand. Maintains ERP system for all Material functional areas such as Item Master, BOM, ship to locations, and inventory parameters. Assist in coordination and analysis of material in support of inventory build-outs and start-ups of new programs. Cross-training in all production control functions for replacement as needed. Maintenance of all material receipts in helping to maintain an accurate perpetual inventory reporting system. Advise and assist staff (Operations, Production, Production Control, and Purchasing) by periodic analysis and reporting of expedited shipments, supplier rating systems, and monthly inventory levels. Assist in the decision-making process for critical material shortages. Utilize methods for continuous improvement. Tracks component inventory inaccuracies for root cause identification and corrective action(s). Responsible for ensuring the issue(s) are corrected. Responsible for performing daily cycle counts and reconciliation of inventory variances. Responsible to track the status of supplier communication for engineering changes as proposed by program management. Responsible for reporting daily on all key performance measures of the materials department, including inventory valuation, cycle counts and inventory accuracy, and past-due parts. Must be willing to report unsafe conditions, report unsafe acts, participate in safety/ergo committees, participate in safety Kaizen events, participate in blue sky initiatives, participate in safety audits, and participate in safety observation feedback events. Assist the plant in achieving safety goals and achieving and maintaining AMS objectives. Participate in communications events such as plant-wide meetings, line meetings, department meetings, and training exercises. Will follow and promote environmental management system compliance and commitment to resource conservation.
cond_0509.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
College degree or equivalent 2+ years in Production Control with material coordination emphasis
Knowledgeable with ERP systems
Preferred Requirements
Experience with QAD ERP system
Previous experience in Automotive / J-I-T plants
cond_0509.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0509.workplace_support: We believe growth happens in supportive environments, not in isolation. Through mentorship, collaboration, and shared accountability, we create space for employees to learn, contribute, and succeed.
